data.narrative:
Cuby Technologies is a Series B-stage housing and construction company founded by Aleks Gampel and Aleh Kandrashou. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of four private-market peers in adjacent construction and building-tech segments (Plantd Materials, Cover, Somos, and Charge Robotics), with no direct public comparables available at this stage of market development.

The primary applicable method is stage-progression analysis. Using Cuby's $23.4M in total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier consistent with Series B to subsequent-stage financing progression, the analysis implies a valuation of $44M. This represents the median point of the triangulated range, which extends from $38M (low) to $51M (high), anchored to standard venture stage dynamics rather than detailed margin or growth-rate comparables.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $38M to $51M, with a median estimate of $44M. Material uncertainty attaches to the absence of public benchmarks and reliance on a single methodological path. The narrow comp set and early-stage nature of construction-tech markets limit granular peer-relative positioning. Valuation sensitivity hinges on the accuracy of the 1.9x stage multiplier as applied to this particular sector and company profile.
